We construct different vocabularies for input texts and questions respectively by keeping words which appear more than twice. Glove (Pennington et al., 2014) is used to initialize word embedding with dimension 300 and the embedding for BIO tag is randomly initialized of size 20. The size of hidden units in LSTM cell in all encoders is 300 while the size of the generation decoder is 1200. The hyperparameters to balance weights of losses are chosen as $\lambda = 0.5$ and $\beta = 0.1$ . We evaluate our model on validation set to choose parameters.
